title: Recording: Great Cock And Seagull Race by Paul McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul McCartney recorded ‘Great Cock And Seagull Race’ on 23 February 1971.

The instrumental track was recorded under the working title ‘Blues’. McCartney played all instruments.

More overdubs were added by Wings on 17 December 1971, with a new coda containing more guitars, electric piano, and tambourine.

The recording was mixed later that day by Dixon Van Winkle, and McCartney played it during an appearance on WCBS-FM. ‘Great Cock And Seagull Race’ subsequently appeared on bootleg collections with the title ‘Breakfast Blues’.

The track was officially released on the 2012 reissue of Ram.
